title: Technology Sector Update for 10/12/2018: BILI,IMOS,LDOS,LLL,AIR

Technology stocks were easily outpacing other sectors in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding more than 2.1% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 1.3%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Bilibili ( BILI ) has jumped out to a more than 6% advance Friday, that followed the Chinese online entertainment platform signing a a strategic partnership with the Houston Rockets of the NBA to expand the basketball team's eSports presence. Under the new tie-up, Bilibili becomes the official partner of Clutch Gaming, the Rockets' eSports team. The team and the company also are planning for friendly basketball competitions each year, and the Clutch Gaming team will broadcast their games in real time on the Bilibili platform.
In other sector news:
(+) ChipMOS Technologies ( IMOS ) was maintaining most its nearly 4% gain on Friday after the specialty chipmaker said it has filed a capital reduction request with the Nasdaq Stock Market, seeking approval of ITS plan to return about TWD1.5, or about $0.05, to investors for each of their American depositary shares.
(-) Leidos Innovations ( LDOS ) was nearly 1% lower in afternoon trading, giving back a 2% gain earlier Friday that followed the cybersecurity and data management company being selected to share in a $25.5 billion, 10-year contract to supply global logistics and related support services for the US Department of Defense, the Pentagon said late Thursday. Several other companies are participating in the project, including L-3 Technologies ( LLL ) and AAR Corp ( AIR ), the Defense Department said, adding work locations and funding will be determined with each order.
